summary: I issued the Level 1 and Level 2 Milestone Schedule (Baseline) narrative and the M00-M14 milestone table, folding in the KOM decisions on the Meridian review route and the 10 January 2027 target approval date. I recorded the WBS and procurement inputs still due from Engineering and SCM by 8 December (ACTIONS-000-006/007), chased both owners, and sent the document to Sophie Laurent for review. A040 progress is updated.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
paragraphs: This document presents the Level 1 (project milestone) and Level 2 (summary/phase) baseline schedule for the HELIOS 100 MW Solar PV + BESS Power Plant (HEL001), Qizilqum Solar Site, Navoi Region. It covers contract signature (M00, 2026-12-01) to Provisional Acceptance (M14, 2028-05-31) and is aligned with the outline presented at the Kick-off Meeting (M02, 2026-12-03) and with activity A040 (Baseline schedule L1-L3 and approval) of the Baseline Schedule Development Plan HEL001-G000-P-&SCH-00001-A.

The Level 3 working schedule (logic-linked, resource-loaded activities, P6 native and xlsx export) is generated from the same WBS and will follow once the Engineering and Supply Chain inputs listed in Section 6 are received. Nothing in this document replaces the Contract Time for Completion of 18 months; it only describes how HEP intends to achieve it.

sections.heading: 2. Basis of Schedule
bullets: Contract: FIDIC Silver Book 2017 (amended), signed 2026-12-01 (Day 0); Notice to Proceed 2026-12-15; Time for Completion 18 months; PAC target 2028-05-31.
Delay LDs 0.5% per week capped at 10% of Contract Price; therefore float on the PAC path is protected and not consumed by internal targets.

Scope: 100 MWac / 128 MWp PV in four blocks (PV1-PV4), 206,500 modules of 620 Wp, 28 central inverter stations of 3.6 MVA, single-axis trackers, BESS 50 MW / 100 MWh, 33/220 kV plant substation, 9 km 220 kV OHTL.
Calendar: site works Monday to Saturday; Sunday non-working; Uzbekistan public holidays and Ramadan/winter weather allowances to be applied at Level 3.

Site conditions: desert plateau, 310-335 m elevation, ground frozen/cold in winter and extreme heat in summer; 12 km unpaved access from the A-380 highway. Winter 2027 and summer 2027 productivity allowances will be applied to civil and piling durations at Level 3.

Durations at this level are deliberately conservative and are not yet supported by subcontractor programmes; they are to be validated against Engineering, SCM and subcontractor inputs before the L3 baseline is frozen.

sections.heading: 5. Review Route and Approval Target (KOM Decisions)
paragraphs: At the Kick-off Meeting the review route for the baseline schedule was agreed with Meridian Energy Consultants (OWE). HEP submits the L1/L2 milestone schedule first, followed by the L3 schedule, and the Owner's Engineer (Sophie Laurent) reviews on behalf of Qizilqum Solar Energy JSC (Khalid Al-Mansoori), with comments consolidated through the document control transmittal route. This follows the proposal in letter HEL001-L-PL-HEP-OWE-0001.

The agreed target for approval of the baseline schedule is 10 January 2027, which is consistent with the finish of A040 in the current schedule. To hold that date, HEP proposes: L1/L2 comments from OWE within five working days of this issue; L3 submission after receipt of the Engineering and SCM inputs; one comment round with one resubmission; and OWE/QSE written approval no later than 2027-01-10. Any slip in OWE review time beyond these periods will be recorded and, where it affects contractual dates, notified in accordance with the Contract.
bullets: Receipt of Engineering and SCM inputs: 2026-12-08.
L3 draft submission to OWE: to be confirmed once inputs are validated; planned before the end of December 2026.

sections.heading: 6. Outstanding Inputs (ACTIONS-000-006 and ACTIONS-000-007)
paragraphs: The L3 schedule cannot be logic-linked without the inputs below. Both actions are due by 8 December 2026. I will report their status in the next weekly schedule update, and any late input will directly reduce the float available to the 10 January 2027 approval target.

rows: Engineering WBS and deliverable list: design packages, drawing and calculation list by area (PV1-PV4, BES, PSS, GSS, TL1), review durations, expected submission dates for Basic Design
Procurement inputs: long-lead item list, RFQ/award dates, vendor lead times for modules, trackers, inverters, BESS and HV equipment, delivery windows to site
Subcontractor outline durations and mobilisation dates (civil, MMS, electrical, substation)

sections.heading: 7. Critical Path, Risks and Assumptions
paragraphs: The preliminary driving path runs through NTP, land access and surveys, Basic Design approval (M04), Construction Permit (M07), first piling (M08), module delivery (M09), mounting and electrical works, substation energisation (M10), back-feed (M11), BESS commissioning (M12), performance test (M13) and PAC (M14). Total float to M14 on this path is limited and I regard it as optimistic until supported by subcontractor durations.

Principal schedule risks recorded at this stage are: delay in permit or land documentation (A110, M07); late Basic Design approval; module supply contract award after 2027-02-15; unpaved access and winter conditions affecting early works; UzGridCo energisation permit timing; and limited float between M13 and M14 (16 days).
bullets: Assumption: NTP is issued on 2026-12-15 with all preconditions satisfied.
Assumption: OWE review periods follow Section 5.
Assumption: Client-provided inputs, land access and grid connection agreement arrive as per the contract programme.
Any change in these assumptions will be assessed through a time impact analysis before notification.

sections.heading: 8. Next Steps
bullets: Collect WBS and procurement inputs by 2026-12-08 and run the logic and duration review with Priya Nair and Dilnoza Rashidova.
Build and issue the L3 schedule with resource and cost loading hooks for S-curve and EVM.
Update schedule weekly and report A040 progress in the weekly report.
Submit L1/L2 to OWE via transmittal and track comments in the document register.

letters.subject: Submission for Review - Level 1 and Level 2 Milestone Schedule (Baseline), HEL001
body_paragraphs: Dear Ms Laurent, further to our letter HEL001-L-PL-HEP-OWE-0001 and the review route agreed at the Kick-off Meeting on 3 December 2026, we submit herewith the Level 1 and Level 2 Milestone Schedule (Baseline), Rev A, for your review. The document contains the milestone table M00-M14 and the summary programme by work package.

In line with the agreed route, we request your comments within five working days of receipt so that the Level 3 schedule can be submitted and the baseline approved by the target date of 10 January 2027. The Level 3 submission will follow once the Engineering WBS and procurement inputs, due internally on 8 December 2026, have been validated.
We remain available to walk through the document at your convenience.
